source: Sölden interactive piste map data (winter.intermaps.com/soelden/data?lang=de, the map on soelden.com): every slope by number and colour (blue, red, black; ski routes stored as ski route); Sölden's list gives numbers only
lifts_source: winter.intermaps.com/soelden/data (lifts), lift numbers removed, fetched 2026-11-24; Rosskirpl and Langegg written as on the map (Roßkirplbahn, Langeggbahn)
numbers_note: numbers whose pieces carry different colours are matched by name only: 22
same_as_note: The resort lists the routes down to the Gaislachalm huts as private ski routes; OpenStreetMap names them Gaislachalm. The list's rating (ski route) is also stored under the map's name.

lifts_explained.Hochsölden-Rotkogl: the map's Rotkogl I and Rotkogl II (OpenStreetMap ref C38): the two sections of this ten-seat gondola
